projects.title: “Say My Name”  iOS App
projects.description: Developed iOS App in Microsoft Company-wide Hackathon. Designing and developing a POC app that enables deaf/hard of hearing users to receive an alarm/notification in both iPhone and Apple Watch when custom set keywords (user input) are heard by a phone. Developed in Swift, team of 2.

projects.title: "A11y" Mobile App
projects.description: Hackathon project. Designing an accessible UI and implementing app in React Native (Android/iOS) to provide indoor navigation provided by business owners for blind and visually impaired people using native phone sensors, with a team of 3 for hackathon. Our system provides a direction and helpful information about businesses that the person may not be familiar with. Worked on full stack
